title: Build, test and verify
summary: Commands to build, test, play and verify.
bodyHtml:
Requires Node 22.18 or newer. Run from the repo root.

Everyday

  • npm install
  • npm test: unit, content, invariant and pillar tests (test/).
  • npm run typecheck: core, tools and the web client.
  • npm run validate: manifests and referenced paths.

Run all three before committing. Keep src/game/ free of engine, rendering and Node imports.

Play

  • npm run web:build writes dist/the-great-haze.html; open it in a browser. Add #fast to speed cinematics. -- --inline bundles Three.js for offline use.
  • npm run play -- --seed 7 --name Jo --background nurse: terminal player.

Verify

  • npm run web:smoke: builds and plays the 3D client in headless Chromium.
  • node tools/web-scene.mjs out.png tools/scenes/<setup>.js 9000: render one situation.
  • W=1280 H=720 node tools/web-play.mjs <outdir> <steps>: play through the UI with a screenshot per new screen kind.
  • Set CHROME_PATH to a local Chrome, or run npx playwright-core install chromium once.
  • npm run simulate -- 200 normal (or dire): balance report across bot strategies.
  • npm run trace -- cautious 7: full transcript of one bot run.

Video

npm run video:export, video:bake, video:server. All dry-run by default; see Story and video pipeline.

Project rules

  • project.dtproject is the single project authority; use shared project-format transaction APIs for registry changes.
  • Make meaningful local Git checkpoint commits; origin is https://github.com/kvick-games/the-great-haze.git.
  • Never commit generated media (outputs/, .hyperlab/).
  • These wiki pages are stored under Design/wiki/ and edited with python D:\Dreamatron\Apps\DT_Design\scripts\dtwiki.py --project <repo>\project.dtproject put ....
